correctness.rationale: For one equivalence E, equality and k unary predicates, atomic guards carry at most two distinct E-related variables. Equality-aware guarded back-and-forth is sustained by each E-class 0/1/>=2 colour supply, and different spectra are separated by explicit rank-3 GF class-existence sentences. One class for each nonzero vector in {0,1,2}^{c} gives the canonical model. The all-profiles GF sentence forces sum of all profile coordinates c*3^c distinct elements, proving optimal B_k=c*3^c, exact 2^(3^c-1)-1 theories, and effective rank-3 collapse for all nonempty finite/infinite domains. Independently evaluated combinatorial totals for k=0..3; this finite arithmetic is not the all-structure proof.
residual_risks: Standard guarded-bisimulation preservation is an imported theorem; it was checked against the restricted signature, not reproved in general.
